description: The failure object a failed run carries. All nine codes, each with the retryability the backend assigns it.

valid.why: no_eligible_attendees: the room is what is wrong, so retrying it unchanged would fail identically

payload.message: Nobody has checked in with a completed questionnaire yet.

valid.why: invalid_matching_input: an answer reached the matcher in a shape it cannot score

payload.message: Some answers could not be read. Check the guest list and try again.

valid.why: partition_unsatisfied: valid input, no valid seating

payload.message: These guests cannot be split into tables under the current rules.

valid.why: dependency_timeout: retryable, and the exception is kept in Sentry rather than here

payload.message: Matching took too long to reach a service it needs.
A service matching needs is unavailable right now.

valid.why: persistence_failed: publication is atomic, so nothing partial was left behind

payload.message: We could not save the tables. No groups were published.
We could not start matching. Try again in a moment.
Matching stopped responding. You can safely run it again.

valid.why: internal_failure: retryable because publication is atomic, and the reference is the only thing support needs

payload.message: Something went wrong on our side. Quote this reference to support.

valid.why: a reference at the eight-character floor

invalid.why: claims an eligibility failure is retryable, which would offer a button that cannot work
claims a timeout is not retryable, which would send the organizer to support for something a retry fixes
a raw exception smuggled into the reference, which is the exact leak this change exists to close

payload.reference: ValueError: cannot partition 3 people into groups of 5

invalid.why: a reference shorter than eight characters, too ambiguous to quote in a support thread
an empty message, which renders as a failure that says nothing
retryable missing, so the client has to guess whether to offer a retry
no reference at all, leaving a terminal failure with nothing to quote
